overview_description.description:
Shred Video, a new startup launching out of Y Combinator, allows users to take footage from their iPhone, GoPro or drone and simply match it with a song from the user’s iTunes library. That’s all. Shred Video does the rest of the work.

Taking into account the acceleration of the camera itself, Shred Video can pin-point the moments of action for surfers, snowboarders, skaters and other acceleration-based sports to highlight all of the coolest clips in your footage. And beyond that, Shred Video matches those epic moments with the beat-drop of the song.

product.name: Automated Video & Photo Capture System
product.description: A system that uses LiDar, GPS, and smart camera technology to automatically capture videos and photos of adventure tours and activities.

product.name: Automated Video Editing and Production
product.description: Proprietary algorithms automatically edit and produce cinematic-quality videos from captured footage within seconds after the activity ends.

identifier.value: Instant Media Delivery and Viewing Platform

product.name: Instant Media Delivery and Viewing Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that delivers videos and photos instantly to customers via branded web pages and touchscreen displays at the tour site.

product.name: Theatre and Touchscreen Display Setup
product.description: On-site installation of theatre and touchscreen displays for customers to watch and interact with their videos and photos in a cinematic environment.

product.name: Custom Integration and Ongoing Support
product.description: Tailored system integration for specific tour operations combined with continuous technical support and system updates.
